evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Large radial tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with severe extrusion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Broad areas of high grade cartilage loss at the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau.
evidence.Lateral OA: Low grade cartilage loss at the central lateral tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High grade fissuring at the medial and lateral patellar facets.
evidence.Effusion: Moderate joint effusion with synovial proliferation.
evidence.Synovitis: Moderate joint effusion with synovial proliferation.
evidence.Contusion: Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process.
